figures.finding: Mayotte, a department-region of France (where national laws and regulations apply by right under Article 73 of the Constitution), has worked under France's general Labour Code since 1 January 2018, when the separate Mahoran labour code was repealed; no film or stage agreement of Mayotte's own was found, so a performer's, writer's or director's terms there follow France's (whether each national screen agreement's extension reaches Mayotte is a blocker).

value.basis: Loi n° 2016-1088 du 8 août 2016; ordonnance n° 2017-1491 du 25 octobre 2017 (Code du travail applied to Mayotte from 2018-01-01)

figures.finding: No film fund of Mayotte's own operates: in June 2025 the department's culture vice-president told Cannes that Mayotte is the only French territory without a three-year cinema convention with the CNC and the Ministry of Culture, and talks to sign a first one had restarted.

value.status: negotiation of a first triennial convention (CNC, DAC Mayotte, Office Culturel Départemental), June 2025

sources.said: la vice-présidente a rappelé que Mayotte était le seul territoire français à ne pas bénéficier d’une convention triennale avec le Centre national du cinéma et de l’image animée (CNC) et le Ministère de la Culture. Son discours a permis de relancer les discussions entre le CNC, la Direction des Affaires Culturelles (DAC) de Mayotte et l’OCD. Ces échanges ont pour objectif la signature d’une première convention triennale, visant à structurer durablement le soutien au secteur cinématographique et audiovisuel de Mayotte.
